mapper.select: SELECT rownum seqNo,t.* from (SELECT distinct T1.UPDATE_TIME, to_char(T1.SETTLE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, to_char(T1.Update_Time,'hh24:mi:ss') jiaoShouDate, nvl(T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,rfpd.TERM_TYPE) finprodMarketId, T2.Finprod_Abbr finprodAbbr, T1.SETTLE_NUM settleNum, T1.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt, T1.OPER_TYPE operType, decode(T1.UPDATE_USER,'SYSTEM','系统自动处理',T1.UPDATE_USER) createUser FROM TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T0 LEFT JOIN TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_FLOW T1 ON T0.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T0.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T4 ON T0.TRADE_ID =T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT rfpd on T3.FINPROD_ID = rfpd.FINPROD_ID WHERE T0.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} ORDER BY T1.UPDATE_TIME DESC) t

SELECT distinct T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T4.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T1.PS ps, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T1.SHARE_AMT/100 qty, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory,/*理论还本金额*/ T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TO_CHAR(T1.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, TO_CHAR(T1.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, T1.TRADE_AMT AS totalAmtTheory FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}

SELECT distinct T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T4.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T1.PS ps, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T1.SHARE_AMT/100 qty, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory,/*理论还本金额*/ T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TO_CHAR(T1.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate, TO_CHAR(T1.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, T1.TRADE_AMT AS totalAmtTheory FROM TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PROD_TEMP_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}

SELECT ROWNUM rowNums, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TPD.SHARE_AMT/100 QTYD, TPD.SHARE_AMT*100 QTYDQ, TPD.PRIN_AMT prinAmtTheoryd, TPD.INT_AMT intAmtTheoryd, TPD.CPRICE_AMT cpriceAmt, TPD.INT_AMT intAmt, TPD.FPRICE_AMT fpriceAmt, ttft.fee_amt jyFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, TPD.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, TPDA.Entrust_Id entrustId, EE.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, (nvl(ee.entrust_num,0) - nvl(efs.finish_amt,0))/100 unFinshAmt, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, TPD.YIELD*100 matureYield, TPD.EXER_YIELD*100 exeYield, EE.BUSINESS_MODEL busiTypePosition, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE unitPrice, TPD.TRADE_AMT as totalAmtTheory FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft ON tpd.trade_id = ttft.trade_id AND ttft.fee_type =#{feeType06} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft1 ON tpd.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND ttft1.fee_type =#{feeType08} LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON TPDA.Entrust_Id = ee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN ETR_FINISH_STATUS efs ON ee.Entrust_Id = efs.entrust_id AND TPD.TRADE_ID = efs.trade_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID where TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and TPD.Trade_Status='01'

SELECT ROWNUM rowNums, TPDA.Entrust_Id entrustId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TPD.SHARE_AMT qtyd, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, EE.BUSINESS_MODEL busiTypePosition, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft1 ON tpd.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND ttft1.fee_type = #{feeType08} LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON TPDA.Entrust_Id = ee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID where TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and TPD.Trade_Status = '01'

SELECT ROWNUM rowNums, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TPD.SHARE_AMT/100 QTYD, TPD.SHARE_AMT*100 QTYDQ, TPD.PRIN_AMT prinAmtTheoryd, TPD.INT_AMT intAmtTheoryd, TPD.CPRICE_AMT cpriceAmt, TPD.INT_AMT intAmt, TPD.FPRICE_AMT fpriceAmt, ttft.fee_amt jyFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, TPD.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, TPDA.Entrust_Id entrustId, EE.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, (nvl(ee.entrust_num,0) - nvl(efs.finish_amt,0))/100 unFinshAmt, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, TPD.YIELD*100 matureYield, TPD.EXER_YIELD*100 exeYield, EE.BUSINESS_MODEL busiTypePosition, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE unitPrice, TPD.TRADE_AMT as totalAmtTheory FROM TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL TPD INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft ON tpd.trade_id = ttft.trade_id AND ttft.fee_type =#{feeType06} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft1 ON tpd.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND ttft1.fee_type =#{feeType08} LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON TPDA.Entrust_Id = ee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN ETR_FINISH_STATUS efs ON ee.Entrust_Id = efs.entrust_id AND TPD.TRADE_ID = efs.trade_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID where TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and TPD.Trade_Status='01'

SELECT ROWNUM rowNums, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TPD.SHARE_AMT/100 QTYD, TPD.SHARE_AMT*100 QTYDQ, TPD.PRIN_AMT prinAmtTheoryd, TPD.INT_AMT intAmtTheoryd, TPD.CPRICE_AMT cpriceAmt, D.M_INT_AMT mintAmt, T8.M_TRADE_AMT fpriceAmt, ttft.fee_amt jyFeeAmt, ttft1.fee_amt jsFeeAmt, TPD.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, TPDA.Entrust_Id entrustId, nvl(nvl(T10.INV_AIM,e.INV_AIM),ee.PRICE_MODEL) priceModel, (nvl(ee.entrust_num,0) - nvl(efs.finish_amt,0))/100 unFinshAmt, ssai.sec_acct_name secAcctId, TPD.YIELD*100 matureYield, TPD.EXER_YIELD*100 exeYield, EE.BUSINESS_MODEL busiTypePosition, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE unitPrice, T8.DIS_FACE_VALUE as disFaceValue, T9.RATE * 100 as tradeYield, T8.M_TRADE_AMT as mtradeAmt FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT D on D.FINPROD_ID=TPD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft ON tpd.trade_id = ttft.trade_id AND ttft.fee_type =#{feeType06} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttft1 ON tpd.trade_id = ttft1.trade_id AND ttft1.fee_type =#{feeType08} LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON TPDA.Entrust_Id = ee.entrust_id LEFT JOIN ETR_FINISH_STATUS efs ON ee.Entrust_Id = efs.entrust_id AND TPD.TRADE_ID = efs.trade_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO T7 ON T7.Trd_Id = TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T8 ON T8.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = nvl(T7.PRE_TRADE_ID,TPD.B_TRADE_ID) left join REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL T10 on T10.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=T8.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T9 on T9.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE e on e.ENTRUST_ID=ee.ENTRUST_ID where TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and TPD.Trade_Status='01'

MERGE INTO TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO tbms USING ( select
#{settleSeqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleSeqNo,
#{settleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleStatus,
#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} tradeId,
#{settleDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} settleDate,
#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} finprodId,
#{settleNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleNum,
#{settleAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleAmt,
#{busiType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} busiType,
#{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createUser,
#{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createDept,
#{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} createTime,
#{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} updateUser,
#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark,
#{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} updateTime
from dual ) TEMP
ON (tbms.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = TEMP.settleSeqNo)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
tbms.SETTLE_STATUS = TEMP.settleStatus,
tbms.TRADE_ID = TEMP.tradeId,
tbms.SETTLE_DATE = TEMP.settleDate,
tbms.FINPROD_ID = TEMP.finprodId,
tbms.SETTLE_NUM = TEMP.settleNum,
tbms.SETTLE_AMT = TEMP.settleAmt,
tbms.BUSI_TYPE = TEMP.busiType,
tbms.CREATE_USER = TEMP.createUser,
tbms.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.createDept,
tbms.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.createTime,
tbms.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.updateUser,
tbms.REMARK = TEMP.remark,
tbms.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.updateTime
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
SETTLE_SEQ_NO
,SETTLE_STATUS
,TRADE_ID
,SETTLE_DATE
,FINPROD_ID
,SETTLE_NUM
,SETTLE_AMT
,BUSI_TYPE
,CREATE_USER
,CREATE_DEPT
,CREATE_TIME
,UPDATE_USER
,UPDATE_TIME
,REMARK
) values(
TEMP.settleSeqNo
,TEMP.settleStatus
,TEMP.tradeId
,TEMP.settleDate
,TEMP.finprodId
,TEMP.settleNum
,TEMP.settleAmt
,TEMP.busiType
,TEMP.createUser
,TEMP.createDept
,TEMP.createTime
,TEMP.updateUser
,TEMP.updateTime
